comment: The corpus of the three-way merge on states nobody wrote (docs/synchronisation.md §11): 60 draws of two devices that edit a common ancestor (src/shared/sync-merge-draws.test-support.ts, seed 20261119), and what the merge of the Mac (src/shared/sync-merge.ts) gives. It is a file snapshot: src/shared/sync-merge.test.ts rewrites it with `pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/sync-merge.test.ts -u` and refuses a difference otherwise, and LuciumKit (SyncMergeVectorTests) plays it against the Swift merge. A snapshot is {entities, tombstones, order, orderStamps}; `base: null` is the empty base; `conflicts` are in the order of (kind, id, field).
